info.description: Scryfall provides a REST-like API for accessing Magic: The Gathering card data programmatically. It offers endpoints to retrieve cards, sets, images, and other related data in an easy-to-consume format.
info.title: Scryfall API
info.tagline: Query Magic: The Gathering cards, sets, rulings, and high-resolution card images over a JSON REST API
info.about_md:
[Scryfall](https://scryfall.com) is a community-run search engine and data service for [Magic: The Gathering](https://magic.wizards.com). The Scryfall API exposes the same card, set, and ruling data that powers the Scryfall website over a JSON REST interface at `https://api.scryfall.com`.

The API is organised around a few core resources: individual cards (with multiple lookup strategies such as by name, set/collector number, or Scryfall ID), set objects, rulings, card symbols and mana costs, plus bulk-data snapshots for downloading the full database as a single file.

CORS is enabled so the API can be called directly from browser code. Scryfall publishes large daily bulk-data files for users who need the full corpus rather than per-card lookups.

entity_desc.bulk_data: Bulk-data snapshots of the entire Scryfall database (default cards, all cards, rulings, etc.) listed under `/bulk-data`.
entity_desc.card: An individual Magic: The Gathering card, retrievable by Scryfall ID, name, set + collector number, or other identifiers under `/cards`.
entity_desc.card_list: A paginated list of card objects returned by search and listing endpoints such as `/cards/search`.
entity_desc.card_symbol_list: List of card symbols (mana symbols, tap, etc.) used in Magic card text, served from `/symbology`.
entity_desc.catalog: Reference catalogues of known values (card names, creature types, keyword abilities, and similar) under `/catalog`.
entity_desc.mana_cost: Parsed representation of a mana cost string, including converted mana cost and colours, via `/symbology/parse-mana`.
entity_desc.migration: Records of card migrations and merges that change canonical Scryfall IDs over time, listed under `/migrations`.
entity_desc.set: A Magic: The Gathering set (expansion, core set, supplemental product, etc.) accessible under `/sets`.
